policy: The complete connected character and sword are drawn together. No head, neck or weapon cut-and-paste in this new candidate. Original approved source stays byte-identical.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Draw one finished game battle sprite, not a parts collage.
Input 1 is the approved SX knight full character. Input 2 is a zoom of the SAME original helmet. Input 3 clarifies the approved sword shape only. These are design references. Draw the entire figure and held sword together with continuous coherent anatomy, metal forms and perspective. Do NOT cut and paste parts. User explicitly rejects detached helmet composition and wants it DRAWN.

A SINGLE full-body SX knight in a strong grounded sword-slash preparation pose, turned front-right three-quarter like original. Both boots planted apart, forward knee bent slightly, torso has a small athletic coil. Right hand at waist/lower-chest, holding the full greatsword diagonally forward-down-right, with the whole blade and point inside frame. Left arm provides counterbalance. Cape trails gently back-left in large coherent blue/black panels.
Do not change the character identity: exact royal/cobalt blue armor panels, polished silver/ivory armor, narrow ornamental gold trim, large angular shoulder plates, same blue/black/gold full cape. Adult natural proportions as input. No new adornments.
Draw the ORIGINAL helmet convincingly attached to neck and shoulders, at the original proportion: swept silver/gold side plates, compact central blue crest and blue forehead jewel, narrow cyan eyes under angular brow, smooth broad silver/ivory faceplate tapering to a sharp chin. Face readable from front-right three-quarter. No long horns behind the head, no new tall spikes, no beak-like face, no skeletal mouth, no missing jaw, no black cylindrical neck, no tiny head. Keep the design in input 2, no reinterpretation.
Draw the greatsword with the ORIGINAL broad ivory double-edged blade, raised ornate GOLD central spine, large star/sun-shaped ornate gold guard with a round central medallion, long black wrapped handle and gold pommel. Blade must look like a substantial two-handed GREATSWORD, not a narrow rapier or needle. Keep straight parallel tapering edges and sharp original point. Match the visible original blade width-to-length and length-to-body proportions. Align the hand grip, wrist, handle, guard, blade spine and tip coherently as one rigid weapon; no floating guard or duplicate handle, no disconnected parts. Fingers wrap naturally around the grip. Do not replace it with a generic sword or recolor it blue.
Style: same sumptuous painted game armor finish as original, clear fine detail, not anime chibi, no mechanical kitbash/collage. Light is coherent across helmet, body, hand, sword. Genuine transparent RGBA background; no floor, shadow plane, scene, title, text, labels, watermark, glow/VFX yet. One full character only, 1024x1536 portrait, generous clear border around cape, helmet, boots and sword tip. Render at large scale for head and grip inspection. Preserve the approved underlying design while changing only the connected pose.
